analysis_role: development observability/conditioning analysis only; no EKF controller implemented

dataset.current_measurement_noise: none; saved current is the exact simulated state and is fed directly to the auxiliary LSTM

continuous_dynamics.dT_L_dt: 0 deterministic; future EKF process noise models slow random walk

discretization.method: exact tangent Jacobian of the explicit fixed-input RK4 state map used by frozen V3/C4 closed-loop evaluators
discretization.note: The saved dataset itself was generated with solve_ivp(max_step=0.01); RK4 is used here because it is the exact frozen closed-loop plant step relevant to the future comparator.

structural_observability.rank_condition: rank=3 for finite positive L,J when Kb != 0; friction slope, input voltage, current, speed and load do not alter this algebraic rank condition
structural_observability.physical_path: omega affects current through back-EMF; T_L affects omega_dot and reaches current through the omega-to-back-EMF path

normalization_for_conditioning.reason: raw observability conditioning mixes A, rad/s and N*m state units; dimensionless scaling is primary for numerical comparisons
